pending_part_2.title: PART 2: The Secret Map of Roanoke #shorts #mystery
pending_part_2.description: PART 2 (FINALE): Invisible ink on a 400-year-old map reveals the truth of Roanoke. #shorts #viral #mystery
pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part 1, we explored the mysterious disappearance of Roanoke's one hundred and fifteen colonists, but newly analyzed British Museum artifacts have rewritten the story. When scientists examined Governor John White's original fifteen eighty-five map under specialized ultraviolet light, they discovered a hidden symbol concealed beneath two layers of paper. Covered in invisible starch ink was the exact military symbol for a secret inland fort fifty miles away from the coast. Excavations at that precise inland coordinate recently unearthed sixteenth-century English firearm rings and European ceramic fragments. But why did the English crown deliberately hide their fortress location from the world for over four centuries? What were they fleeing from on that desolate coastline?
